Commentary.Commentary: We are back for Ireland's reply. The players are out in the middle. Richard Ngarava to start with the ball.
...THE CHASE...

We have seen that chasing hasn't been easy so far. Ireland need a good start and someone have to play the anchor role. It is the same pitch as the first game! West Indies failed to chase around 160. Upto you Ireland now. Stay tuned.

Ireland started brilliantly and didn't do much wrong throughout but failed to get rid of Sikandar Raza in the start. It could have been much different but not so. Josh Little was the pick of the bowlers as he claimed three wickets and was economical as well.

Sikandar Raza was the mainstay for Zimbabwe. They lost three wickets inside the Powerplay! Then the likes of Sean Williams, Milton Shumba and Luke Jongwe played around him but Sikandar Raza anchored the innings perfectly. Despite losing partners, Raza played his game and tried to big every time. Zimbabwe have reached a very good score here.
What a knock from Sikandar Raza! He is in the form of his life! The last 12 months have been just brilliant for Raza and he has yet again played what could be a match-winning knock.
OUT! TIMBER! No, he can't! This is full and on middle. Raza clears his front leg and tries to smash it away on the leg side but misses and the ball hits the stumps. ZIMBABWE END WITH 174.
Outside off, this is hit to long off for a single. Can Sikandar Raza finish with a boundary?
FOUR! through the gap! Fuller ball, outside off. Jongwe puts his bat on it, the ball goes off the outside edge and through the gap between backward point and short third man.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
A low full toss on middle. Raza whacks it to long on. Excellent running as they get two runs.
Short in length, outside off. Jongwe pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, cut to deep point for a single. 15 runs off the penultimte over.
FOUR! Another boundary! Short in length and outside off. Jongwe slashes it to deep point. There is a fielder patrolling but he is 5-6 yards away from the ropes.
Wide! Tries the slower ball but bowls way outside off. Jongwe slashes and misses.
This is slow, length and way outside off. Raza tries to drag it to deep mid-wicket but does not hit well. Luckily for him, the ball falls in the vacant region. A single.
Wide! This is way over the tramline. Wided.
A single as this is hit to cover.
Full and outside off. Jongwe goes inside-out over covers for a brace.
FOUR! Too much width, outside off. Jongwe slaps it through point late for a boundary.
Leg bye! Little follows on the leg side. Jongwe misses his clip and it goes to the left of the keeper for a leg bye. 150 up!
On the pads, whipped behind square leg for one.
On a length and on middle. Raza makes room to go over mid off. He hits from the upper half of the bat and the man at mid off was excited for a second but the ball goes above him. Two runs.
FOUR! A welcome boundary and it comes from Raza's blade! This is short and on leg. Raza whacks it over square leg for a boundary.
On the hips, nudged to square leg for a single.
Luke Jongwe walks in next.

OUT! This is full and outside off. Burl tries to break the shackles as n boundary was scored in the last three overs. He swings across but only to hit it high and to long on where Mark Adair takes the skier.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: A bouncer to end the over, this is outside off. Raza swings and misses.
A slower length ball, outside off. Raza slaps it through point for a brace.
A widish yorker, outside off. Raza fails to squeeze it out.
A slower short ball on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This one is angled against Burl. Length and outside off. Burl pokes and misses.
Length ball, outside off. Raza works it to point for a single.
Serves a short one to Burl who sits under it.
Ryan Burl comes in.

OUT! TAKEN! Ireland get the breakthrough! Nice idea but not the execution from Shumba! This is full and on middle. Shumba gets inside the line to paddle it but mistimes and it goes in the hands of Josh Little who takes a simple catch at short fine leg.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Little b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! This is way outside off. Shumba swings and misses.
This is full and on middle. Raza makes room to loft over long off but slices it over backward point. The fielder gives a chase, slides in the deep and saves a single.
This is on a length and outside off. Shumba steps across and mistimes his pull to mid-wicket. One.
Short of a length, outside off, cut hard to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length and outside off. Shumba plays it to cover for a single.
Drops a short ball on middle. Raza looks to pull but misses.
Length ball, outside off, Raza punches but finds cover.
Dropped Length ball, outside of. Shumba pulls it straight back to Curtis Campher and it burst through his hands for a single. That was hit hard.
The short balls are not working for Ireland now! This is around off, it is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller ball, outside off, Raza drives it to deep point for one.
Bye! This is down the leg side. Shumba fails to pull. The keeper fumbles to collect and a wide is given.
Another six for Raza! Drops it short and on off. Raza rocks back and pulls it high over mid-wicket for a biggie. Sikandar Raza is playing a gem of an innings her.
Outside off, drilled to long off for a single.
Too short and outside off. Sikandar Raza cuts it to deep cover for a single.
A single as this is hit to deep cover.
FOUR! Tad short and outside off. Shumba pulls it past mid on for a boundary.
Around off, pushed to cover.
Flatter and outside off, Raza punches it straight to point. 13 runs off this over now.
On off, kept out.
FOUR! AND AGAIN! Floated outside off. Raza smashes it hard and beats the fielder at long off for a boundary.
Short and outside off, cut hard to deep cover for a couple of runs.
SIX! CLEARS THE FENCE! 6th Fifty for Raza in T20I! What a knock! Tossed up, outside off. Raza slogs it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Not giving any chance to the fielder in deep.
Wide! Way outside off. Left for a wide.
Flatter ball, outside off. Raza looks to power it on the off side but mistimes it to point.
Length ball, outside off. Shumba pulls off the top end of his bat and past mid on. Two runs. A huge over for Zimbabwe as the collect 15 runs off it.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Powered! Short of a length and on leg. Cramps Raza for the room but he adjusts quickly to pull to deep square leg for a boundary.
SIX! Sikandar Raza continues to go big! Short and outside off. Raza pulls it hard over deep square leg for a six.
SHARP TWO RUNS! Short ball on middle. Raza mistimes his pull over mid-wicket. The fielder from long on runs across and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A direct hit was needed.
What a ripper from Adair! A length ball, outside off, it held its line. Raza defends inside the line and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short and outside off, pulled past mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
On middle, Shumba drops it to mid-wicket. A bit of miscommunication between the batters for a single but they deny in the end.
Length ball on middle. Raza plays it to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball on middle. Shumba bunts it to square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Shorter and on middle. Raza hops and fends it to mid-wicket awkwardly for one.
Outside off. Blocked by Raza.

OUT! TAKEN! Tag-team work from Ireland and they break the stand that started to trouble them. Flat and outside off. Williams again looks to clear the mid-wicket fence. Mark Adair uses his height as he stretches and takes above his head but sees his momentum taking him over the ropes. He lobs the ball for Harry Tector who takes it with ease inside the ground.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Williams hits one! Tossed up, outside off. Williams slog-sweeps it. He gets more height but enough distance to clear the mid-wicket fence.
A single as this is hit to sweeper cover.
FOUR! Wonderful shot! Flatter ball, outside off. Raza thumps it past cover, no chance for the fielder in the deep. Fout more.
TWO RUNS! Full ball, outside off, a leggie. Raza lofts it to deep cover for a brace.
This is way outside off, dragged to deep mid-wicket for one.
SIX! Raza playing with some aggression! Short in length and on middle. Raza pulls it flat and wide of the fielder at deep sqaure leg.
On middle, kept out.
Short again, angling down. Raza thinks to pull but leaves it alone. He asks for a wide but nothing given.
SIX! CLOBBERED! Short and on middle. Raza hoicks it all the way over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Outside off, cut through point for one.
Length ball, outside off. Raza knocks it through covers for one.
A single to end the over as this is hit to mid-wicket.
Around off, punched to cover.
Full ball, way outside off, Sean looks to drive but gets an outside edge to short third man for a single.
On middle, this one skids on. Raza eases it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Short ball, outside off. Raza rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for four runs.
Floated ball, around off. Sean works it to mid-wicket for one.
A bouncer, outside off. Raza leaves it alone.
On middle, it's pulled to deep square leg for one.
Scrambled seam! Length and outside off. Williams misses his push.
A length ball, outside off. Williams fails to connect his bat.
Length ball, just wide of off. Williams blocks it out.
Length ball, around off. Raza works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball, outside off. Raza punches it through covers for one. Powerplay done! Zimbabwe are on 41/3.
Tossed up on middle, swept to deep square leg for one.
Wide! This one is sliding down. Williams misses his flick. Good work from the keeper again there.
Flatter and outside off, slapped to deep cover for a single.
Sikandar Raza is the new man in.

OUT! STUMPED! The skipper goes now! This is just excellent from Ireland! Singh gets his first one. Craig Ervine comes down the track again. Simi Singh anticipates that and serves it quicker and around leg. Ervine is cramped as he looks to heave but misses and the keeper makes no mistake. Three down now, Zimbabwe.
Commentary.Howout: st Lorcan Tucker b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: On middle. Ervine skips down and eases it to mid off.
Tossed up on off. Kept out.
Sean Williams comes  in.

OUT! TAKEN! The short ball works again and Josh Little has his second wicket! This is on middle. Wesley Madhevere pulls but doesn't connect it well. Gareth Delany at deep square leg judges the flight well and takes it. Wesley Madhevere doesn't make most of the lifeline given.
Commentary.Howout: c Gareth Delany b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball on middle. Wesley Madhevere bunts it to square leg.
FOUR! Touch short and on middle. Wesley Madhevere pulls and hits it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Length and on off. Wesley Madhevere nudges it to square leg for one.
Length ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over! A good one for Zimbabwe as 11 comes off it. On middle, Ervine shuffles across and flicks it to deep square leg for four.
Length ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere punches it to cover for a single.
Drop and run! Outside off, this is hit to backward point for one.
Around off, pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Connected well! Short of a length and on middle, this is pulled hard behind square leg for four runs.
Length ball, angling down. Wesley Madhevere mistimes his pull and it goes to the keeper on a bounce.
Length ball, outside off. Ervine looks to push but misses.

In the air and safe! Zimbabwe batters are troubled by the extra bounce. Short again on middle. Ervine looks to pull but top edges it high and just far away from Simi Singh who runs back from short fine leg to collect. Two runs.
On a length and outside off. Ervine knocks it to cover.
Length and on middle. Defended.
Full again, Wesley Madhevere mistimes his drive to mid on and takes off for a quick single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to covers.
Outside off, worked to deep point for a single.
Wide! Too short and on off. Wesley Madhevere leaves.
FOUR! Dropped! Short ball on middle. Wesley Madhevere pulls it flat. Curtis Campher is standing a few yards out at deep square leg. He mistimes his jump and lets it through his hands for a boundary.
Short in length and on middle, from wide of the crease. Wesley Madhevere looks to work on the leg side but misses.
Leg bye! On the hips, Ervine misses his clip and it goes off the pads to point.
Length ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere guides it past point off the splice for one.
Length ball, outside off. Ervine drops it in front of point for a quick single.
Mark Adair to bowl from the other end.
Length and on middle, played back to the bowler.
FOUR! EDGY RUNS! Short again on middle. Wesley Madhevere mistimes his pull, it goes off the top edge behind the keeper for a boundary.
Four leg byes! Zimbabwe are underway! Too straight from Little. On the pads, Wesley Madhevere misses his flick and it goes off the pads to the fine leg fence.
Length and on middle. Wesley Madhevere blocks it out.
Wesley Madhevere is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Just the start Ireland wanted! What a delivery from Little! This is short and on middle, it nips in and there is extra bounce as well. Regis Chakabva tries to fend it away as he brings his bat up but it probably brushed the gloves before going into the mitts of the keeper, Lorcan Tucker. Looks like it went off the shoulder of the bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Little starts with a bouncer, outside off. Regis Chakabva leaves it alone for the keeper.

We are all set for the action. The Irish players have taken their position. Josh Little to start with the ball. Regis Chakabva and Craig Ervine to open for Zimbabwe. The players take a knee as they support the BLM movement. Let's play...
The players are out in the middle. It is pretty chilly out there. First, the national anthems. It will be Ireland's first followed by Zimbabwe's.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Regis Chakabva (WK), Craig Ervine (C), Wesley Madhevere, Sean Williams, Sikandar Raza, Milton Shumba, Ryan Burl, Luke Jongwe, Tendai Chatara, Richard Ngarava, Blessing Muzarabani.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Andy Balbirnie (C), Paul Stirling, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Harry Tector, Curtis Campher, George Dockrell, Gareth Delany, Mark Adair, Simi Singh, Barry McCarthy, Josh Little.

Craig Ervine, the captain of Zimbabwe says he is happy to bat first. Adds the boundaries are big and it is not easy to chase down. Shares that they have to play good cricket and show everyone that they belong here. Admits Raza is in superb form and Blessing Muzarabani is coming back after the injury.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland says it is a good wicket. Adds they saw the first game and they have an idea of how the pitch will play and admits about the bigger boundaries. Ends by informing his team.
TOSS - Ireland won the toss and they will BOWL first.
So, as expected earlier, Scotland win their game. What a tournament this is turning out to be! Let's now shift our attention to this game. Toss coming up next.
